title: Source and verification code for the paper Weak-Type Endpoint Bounds for Bochner-Riesz Means in Every Dimension

creators.name: Bhattacharjee, Deep
creators.affiliation: Formerly, Electro-Gravitational Space Propulsion Laboratory (EGSPL), Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751030, India

description:
LaTeX source, figures, check program and Lean 4 file of the paper Weak-Type Endpoint Bounds for Bochner-Riesz Means in Every Dimension by Deep Bhattacharjee.

At the critical index lambda(p) = n(1/p - 1/2) - 1/2, the Bochner-Riesz means (1 - |xi|^a/t^a)^lambda_+ in every dimension n >= 2 map L^p to weak L^p for 1 < p < 2n/(n+1), uniformly in t, and converge in weak L^p (Theorem A); they have (p,q) sparse bounds for q > (n-1)p/(n+1-2p), which is sharp except at the corner of the trapezoid of Beltran, Roos and Seeger (Theorem B); and they map L^p(w) to weak L^p(w) for every A_1 weight w in RH_sigma when 1 < p < 1 + (n-1)/(n+1)(1 - 1/sigma) (Theorem C). The new content is n >= 3. The proof reproduces, with credit and complete proofs, OpenAI's preprint 'Local smoothing for the Euclidean wave equation' (25 October 2026), which proves the local smoothing and Bochner-Riesz conjectures, and the epsilon-removal of Beltran, Roos and Seeger, and then applies their sparse domination theorem and the weighted theorem of Frey and Nieraeth.

The Python program checks the algebraic identities and exponent computations; the Lean file proves the exponent arithmetic and the quaternion identities. No statement of the paper depends on them.
